name: Kohinata Daichi
source:
A university student researching insect, especially butterfly, ecology.

After hearing about a butterfly in a mountain village in K district from a professor, he goes there to study it. Though he has a healthy constitution, he's assaulted by dizziness and a summer cold there, where he ends up in the care of Rihito and Tsukito.

[From [url=http://aarinfantasy.com/forum/f16/t177142-22799%3B-24187%3B-12398%3B-24651%3B.html]Aarinfantasy Forums[/url]]
